decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the board with counterspells and removal spells while using card advantage and manipulation to stay ahead of the opponent. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and versatile cards like Prismatic Ending to answer threats efficiently. The inclusion of Blood Sun and Valakut Awakening allows for disruption and card advantage, while the companion Kaheera, the Orphanguard provides additional value. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents, eventually winning through attrition or with late-game threats like Otawara, Soaring City.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade, allowing you to put more threats on the board and disrupt your opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, you can cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Brazen Borrower. With a mix of creatures and spells, you can consistently pressure your opponent and control the game tempo. Additionally, the deck includes countermeasures like Force of Negation to protect your board presence and disrupt your opponent's strategy.

This deck aims to quickly cast powerful spells with Cascade and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By using cards that allow for free casting of spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck can efficiently put pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Force of Negation. The deck also includes versatile spells like Prismari Command and Bonecrusher Giant to handle a variety of situations. Overall, the strategy focuses on speed, disruption, and overwhelming the opponent with Cascade triggers.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board through a combination of removal spells and powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Titania, Protector of Argoth. Utilizing Elementals and cards that synergize with them, the deck aims to maintain board presence and advantage while disrupting the opponent's game plan. With access to powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and strong land ramp spells, the deck is able to outvalue the opponent and grind out victories through attrition and incremental advantage.

Utilizing a toolbox of creatures and combo pieces, this deck aims to create a synergistic chain of effects to overwhelm the opponent. By sacrificing creatures to Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and utilizing cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can generate incremental advantage and drain the opponent's life total. The inclusion of cards like Chord of Calling and Birds of Paradise provide additional flexibility and acceleration, allowing the deck to adapt to different situations and assemble its combo pieces effectively.

The deck focuses on using cycling creatures like Architects of Will and Street Wraith to quickly fill up the graveyard, then cast Living End to bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield for a massive advantage. It also includes disruption with cards like Grief and Force of Negation to control the board and protect the combo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden surge of creatures and take control of the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of Elementals to control the board and disrupt your opponent's game plan. By ramping up with cards like Risen Reef and Omnath, Locus of Creation, while also maintaining control with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Solitude, you can overwhelm your opponent with powerful Elemental creatures. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for extra value by flickering your creatures and permanents for additional card advantage and control. The deck also features a strong mana base to ensure consistency and flexibility in your plays.

This deck focuses on quick aggression and tempo control in order to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to establish their own game plan. Utilizing powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer alongside efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure. The inclusion of Counterspell and Archmage's Charm provides additional control elements, allowing the player to dictate the pace of the game. Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble help dig for key cards and maintain card advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect your own win conditions. With a combination of counterspells, removal, card draw, and efficient creatures like Ragavan and Ice-Fang Coatl, the deck aims to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in longer games. Overall, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping into powerful cascade spells like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst to flood the board with massive creature tokens. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Subtlety and Endurance, as well as removal options such as Bonecrusher Giant and Dead / Gone. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the cascade mechanic while also providing flexibility with lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Ketria Triome. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, consistent aggression backed up by versatile spell choices.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures that can be sacrificed for various effects, such as drawing cards, gaining life, or dealing damage to the opponent. The deck utilizes creatures with undying or persist abilities to provide value when sacrificed, as well as cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for specific creatures. The mana base is optimized to support the combo elements of the deck, with a mix of dual lands and mana producers to ensure consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a powerful creature equipped with Colossus Hammer as quickly as possible, using cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Sigarda's Aid to cheat equipment into play and equip it for free. The deck aims to win the game by swinging for lethal infect or regular damage in just a few turns, overwhelming the opponent with a massive threat. By utilizing various combo pieces and synergies, the deck seeks to create a powerful and streamlined strategy to achieve victory.

This deck focuses on using cascade spells like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to quickly bring out powerful creatures from the graveyard with Living End. By using cards like Architect of Will and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan, this deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with large creatures like Striped Riverwinder and Waker of Waves. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces and maintain control of the game. With a mixture of disruption and explosiveness, this deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly and efficiently control the board while applying pressure through aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck focuses on disruption with cards like Counterspell, Spell Pierce, and Brazen Borrower, while also using card draw and selection with Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. The deck aims to tempo out opponents by combining efficient removal like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt with evasive threats like Murktide Regent. The mana base is set up to ensure the deck can cast its spells consistently and effectively.

This UR Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with efficient creatures and spells. Utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, it aims to apply early pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help maintain card advantage and ensure smooth draws. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, while also using cards like Murktide Regent to close out the game quickly. Overall, the deck focuses on aggression and disruption to secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and planeswalkers such as Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The goal is to delay and disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage with card draw and recursion effects like Snapcaster Mage. The deck is built around a mana base that allows for consistent access to its spells while also including utility lands like Hall of Storm Giants and Castle Vantress. By efficiently answering threats and outvaluing the opponent, the deck aims to establish dominance and win the game through attrition.
